digest.component_or_area: ticket create/edit save-time warning and plan-review gate
propositions: When a ticket (create or edit) is saved with a description exceeding the configured character limit (verify.max_ticket_description_chars, default 8000) and the plan-review claim gate is enabled, a warning must be emitted at save time stating the length, cap, and gate requirement without blocking or altering the write.
The description cap warning must read from the same config key (verify.max_ticket_description_chars) as the existing plan-review admission guard, ensuring single-sourcing of the threshold.

The save-time warning must be surfaced across all surfaces: CLI prints to stderr (while stdout remains pure), the library returns it via rebar logger and return value, and MCP exposes it as a result field (description_warning) on CreateResultOut and WriteAckOut.
When the plan-review gate is disabled, the description is within the cap, or the ticket type is exempt, no warning must be issued and the write must remain unaffected.
The warning implementation must reuse the existing _plan_review_gate_applies() probe to ensure the warning never promises a block the gate would not enforce.
